content.comment_body: Hello, I'm part of a central software deployment team at an institute, where we distribute our software automatically to client machines. I'm attempting to perform an automatic and silent (unattended) installation of [product_name] using the correct parameters for the InstallAnywhere installer as described in [url]. However, the silent installation isn't working with or without a response file. I've tried installing [product_name] [version_no] on Windows XP as well as [version_no] (both 32 and 64 Bit) on Windows 7 64 Bit. Does anyone have any suggestions?

analysis.insight_summary: Users are experiencing problems completing a silent or unattended installation of [product_name] ([version_no]) on Windows platforms using automated deployment solutions. Attempts to leverage installer parameters and response files are unsuccessful, forcing manual intervention and complicating enterprise-level automated software rollouts.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] to offer robust, parameter-based silent/unattended installation compatible with enterprise deployment workflows.
